---
title: "`r params$ticker` Price Report"
output: html_document
params:
  ticker: "TICKER"
  price_data: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set_ggplot_theme()
```

## Price History

```{r price-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_price(params$price_data, params$ticker) %>%
  add_data_callout()
```

## Drawdown from Highs

```{r drawdown-chart, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_drawdown(params$price_data, params$ticker) %>%
  add_data_callout(label_fn = scales::percent)
```
